n05b83abb5b.headline: Oman: More than 40,000 jobs created for Omanis in 2021
n05b83abb5b.summary: Oman created more than 40,000 jobs for Omani nationals in 2021, and 45,708 private sector Omani workers were saved from layoffs. The figures were reported by Gulf News.
n05b83abb5b.why: Employment programmes for nationals in Gulf states affect labour market conditions and private sector hiring.
